name: backfill-legs-won
description: Standalone Admin SDK script — the one-time Stats Rules audit (Season 1) backfill. Reads every currently-confirmed match in the chalkie-app Firebase project (read-only), computes each player's legsWon the same way the live Cloud Function aggregation does, and (only with --apply) writes JUST that one field to playerSeasonStats. Never touches matches, fixtures, or any other field. See README.md before running anything.
